dedupe_keys.name: field level california crop maps flccm 2007 2021

description: The Field-Level California Crop Maps give a crop type for each agricultural field in California for every year from 2007 to 2021. The Zenodo record says reliable crop maps for the state were scarce because of the diversity of its crops, so the authors trained a probability random forest classifier on highly accurate ground-truth labels available for 2014, 2016 and 2018 and applied it across the other years. Version 1 was published on 20 February 2022 by Seunghyun Lee, Aaron Smith and Shanchao Wang as one ZIP of about 134 MB per year, downloadable and free under CC BY 4.0, with coverage of California. Caveats: years without ground truth rely on the trained classifier, and the crop class list and accuracy per year are in the paper, not on the page read. For simulation it gives field-scale crops for drought, heat and wildfire exposure of California agriculture, and for crop water demand in irrigation and groundwater models. Related catalogue records include the USDA NASS Cropland Data Layer and the Corn-Soy Data Layer.
name: Field-Level California Crop Maps (FLCCM) 2007-2021
provider: Seunghyun Lee, Aaron Smith and Shanchao Wang, via Zenodo
